globalCodeData_B4.impactVector: Operatives of the Anti-Kidnapping Squad and TIU arrested four suspects—Muhammad Musa Isma'il, Abubakar Muhammad Isah, Auwal Muhammad, and alleged mastermind Hadiya Rukayya Auwal—over the abduction and murder of 14-year-old Mahmoud Auwal, whose body was recovered and identified by parents, while Special Intervention Squad operatives acting on a November 12, 2026 complaint arrested Mansur Khalil, Nuhu Garba, and Hussaini Aminu along Zaria Road and recovered a ₦14,000,000 Hyundai Elantra.
